title: Hobbies
text:
I enjoy playing FIFA and Call of Duty. These games are competitive and fun, especially playing with friends online. I’m always trying to improve my rank and skills.



I play soccer at a semi-professional level for Boulder United. Soccer is my passion as it keeps me fit, builds teamwork, and the competition pushes me to be better every day.



I play cricket in Division 2 in Colorado for CNYC (Colorado Nepal Youth Cricket). Cricket is a strategic and exciting sport that requires patience and skill. I love the camaraderie and competitive spirit of the league.
